title: Errors began with an orders deploy
query: Errors began the moment orders v1.0.1 was deployed. Payments shows no errors at all and seems to get no traffic.
root_cause: Orders was deployed with a wrong payments endpoint (wrong port), so every payment call is refused.

remediation.detail: Roll orders back to the previous version and configuration (v1.0.0).

evidence: Deploy log shows orders changed from v1.0.0 to v1.0.1 right before the errors
Orders logs show connection errors when calling payments
Payments is healthy and receives no traffic
query_paraphrase: Things broke at the exact moment we shipped version 1.0.1 of orders. Payments looks perfectly fine but also seems to be getting no requests.
